notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant, adding {C}{C}.
Gray Merchant dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least five life and you to gain that much life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1} and two life, removing the +1/+1 counter from Gray Merchant and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
